verdict.rationale: Virtualization and container support is a fair question to ask of a developer-focused chip, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions virtualization, hypervisors, VMs, or Docker. The items cover Xcode simulators, Metal, machine learning, displays and Thunderbolt, none of which shows the capability this story asks about.

support.subject: As a developer, VMs and containers run well on this silicon — documented virtualization support and mainstream hypervisor and Docker workflows
